name: Den bien
summary: Đẻn biển is a small sea snake, also called mãng xà biển, stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, served with bánh đa, simmered as porridge, or minced and fried in rice paper. It is not the fish at Đá Nhảy.
origin: Quảng Bình. A small sea snake, also called mãng xà biển.
howToEat: Du khách on 29 May 2024 names three plates: đẻn xào sả ớt, đẻn with bánh đa, and cháo đẻn.
Du khách on 13 Mar 2024, republishing Báo Đắc Nông, describes ram đẻn: the snake is cleaned, minced, rolled in rice paper, and fried until crisp.
The ward office names the animal with the city’s seafood.
where: With the city’s seafood in Đồng Hới.
seoTitle: Den bien — the Quang Binh sea snake
seoDescription: Đẻn biển is a small sea snake, stir-fried with lemongrass and chili, served with bánh đa, simmered, or fried as ram.
